rules: Every labor line's hourly rate must equal the contract rate card rate for the employee's role.
No employee may be billed more than once for the same week.
Every non-labor charge must be on the contract's allowed list and must not exceed its cap.
Each line amount must equal quantity times unit rate.
The invoice total must equal the sum of the line amounts.
For each labor line, compare the billed hours with the approved hours on that employee's portal timecard for the week; billed hours must not exceed approved hours.
gold.decision_rule: If any check fails, recommend dispute and ask the vendor for a credit memo; otherwise recommend approve.
